thread:
Sophie: heads up — saw some requests from service-account proxy getting billed to the wrong project in the console. Quota shows spike on project: unknown-org-000.
Raj: do you have an example request id? Could be header loss at the proxy.
Sophie: i grabbed a sample — req id `req_8a1b` — attached below. also noticed our attribution tag is missing in traces.
Devon: was this via the new external-exchange proxy? if so, it strips `X-Origin-Project` unless `Forward-Org` header present.
Sophie: yep, came through external-exchange. here's the curl we used:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SA:abcd" -H "X-Origin-Project: proj-42" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate
```
Marta: ops note — console currently maps tokens->projects by `token_project` claim, not x-header. we need to decide precedence.
Kevin: agree. for rollout: backend flag `auth.attribution.header_precedence` default false. canary to 10% orgs for 2 weeks.
Raj: telemetry ask: add `attribution_source` tag to traces (`token_claim` | `x_header` | `proxy_fallback`) and increment metric `attribution.mismatch_count` when they differ.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: feature-flag `auth.attribution.header_precedence` set to off in staging at 03:00 UTC.
Devon: once flag flips, we must also update console UI to show "attribution source" in usage table — UX: small pill with tooltip.
Sophie: also think about retroactive backfill — billing relies on past attribution. we should not rewrite billing but surface potential misattributions in the console.
Marta: +1 — plan: surface "suspected_misattribution" anomalies, add CSV export to ops dashboard for manual review.
Kevin: who owns the rollout runbook? @Marta?
Marta: i'll own runbook and post canary checklist. will need help from @Devon for logs and @Raj for telemetry dashboards.
Sophie: thanks all. i'll open a tiny PR with the sample log and prod query we used.
